verses.literal: - On the day Moses finished setting up - the tabernacle he anointed - and consecrated it - and all its furnishings along with the altar and all its utensils - - -

verses.literal: They brought - as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve . . . oxen an ox from each [leader] and a cart from every two leaders and presented them before the tabernacle

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

verses.transliteration: haš·šə·lā·mîm ū·lə·ze·ḇaḥ šə·na·yim bā·qār ḥă·miš·šāh ’ê·lim ḥă·miš·šāh ‘at·tu·ḏîm ḥă·miš·šāh kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh zeh qā·rə·ban ’ă·ḥî·ra‘ ben- ‘ê·nān
verses.literal: and a peace offering . . . of two oxen five rams five male goats and five male lambs a year old . . . This was the offering of Ahira son of Enan

verses.original: זֹ֣את׀ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה כֶּ֜סֶף קַעֲרֹ֨ת שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר כֶ֙סֶף֙ מִֽזְרְקֵי־ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ זָהָ֖ב כַּפּ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: zōṯ nə·śî·’ê yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bə·yō·wm him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw mê·’êṯ šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ke·sep̄ qa·‘ă·rōṯ šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ḵe·sep̄ miz·rə·qê- šə·têm ‘eś·rêh zā·hāḇ kap·pō·wṯ
verses.literal: [So] these [were the offerings] from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar vvv when it was anointed - - twelve . . . silver platters twelve . . . silver bowls and twelve . . . gold dishes

verses.original: הָֽאַחַת֙ כֶּ֔סֶף הַקְּעָרָ֤ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּמֵאָ֗ה הָאֶחָ֑ד הַמִּזְרָ֣ק וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים כֹּ֚ל כֶּ֣סֶף הַכֵּלִ֔ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃ בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל
verses.transliteration: hā·’a·ḥaṯ ke·sep̄ haq·qə·‘ā·rāh šə·lō·šîm ū·mê·’āh hā·’e·ḥāḏ ham·miz·rāq wə·šiḇ·‘îm kōl ke·sep̄ hak·kê·lîm ’al·pa·yim wə·’ar·ba‘- mê·’ō·wṯ haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·qel
verses.literal: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels . . . and each [silver] bowl seventy [shekels] The total weight of the silver articles [was] two thousand four hundred [shekels] according to the sanctuary shekel

verses.original: שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵה֙ זָהָ֤ב כַּפּ֨וֹת מְלֵאֹ֣ת קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲשָׂרָ֧ה עֲשָׂרָ֛ה הַכַּ֖ף הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל כָּל־ זְהַ֥ב הַכַּפּ֖וֹת וּמֵאָֽה׃ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: šə·têm- ‘eś·rêh zā·hāḇ kap·pō·wṯ mə·lê·’ōṯ qə·ṭō·reṯ ‘ă·śā·rāh ‘ă·śā·rāh hak·kap̄ haq·qō·ḏeš bə·še·qel kāl- zə·haḇ hak·kap·pō·wṯ ū·mê·’āh ‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: The twelve . . . gold dishes filled with incense [weighed] ten [shekels] each according to the sanctuary shekel The total weight of the gold dishes [was] a hundred and twenty [shekels]

verses.original: כָּל־ הַבָּקָ֨ר לָעֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂר֙ אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה וּמִנְחָתָ֑ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּשְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hab·bā·qār lā·‘ō·lāh šə·nêm ‘ā·śār pā·rîm šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’ê·lim šə·nêm ‘ā·śār kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh ū·min·ḥā·ṯām šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ū·śə·‘î·rê ‘iz·zîm lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve . . . bulls twelve . . . rams and twelve . . . male lambs a year old . . . together with their grain offerings and twelve . . . male goats . . . for the sin offering

verses.original: וְכֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר׀ זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ שִׁשִּׁים֙ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁ֔ים עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֑ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֖ה זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl bə·qar ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh pā·rîm šiš·šîm ’ê·lim šiš·šîm ‘at·tu·ḏîm šiš·šîm kə·ḇā·śîm bə·nê- šā·nāh zōṯ ḥă·nuk·kaṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’a·ḥă·rê him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four . . . bulls sixty rams sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old . . . This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed -

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֜ה וּבְבֹ֨א אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּוֹ֒ וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת־ הַקּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִ֑ים מֵעַ֤ל הַכַּפֹּ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ū·ḇə·ḇō ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw way·yiš·ma‘ ’eṯ- haq·qō·wl mid·dab·bêr ’ê·lāw mib·bên šə·nê hak·kə·ru·ḇîm mê·‘al hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- ’ă·rōn hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: When Moses entered . . . the Tent of Meeting to speak with [the LORD] he heard - the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat - on the ark of the Testimony Thus [the LORD] spoke to him
